Adiastematic Search

You can search for melodies in the Corpus Monodicum dataset that constrain to a certain contour. Syntax updates:
  • u / d / r – Up, Down, Repeat
  • _ – Syllable boundary (e.g., _ u d _ searches for exactly a two-interval syllable contour)
  • _ _ – A single note syllable (zero intervals)
  • [...] – Skip any amount of unknown notes (mapped to .*)
  • [u|d] – Alternative options (mapped to (u|d) in regex)
  • ^ / $ – Start / End of the chant
(Note: Spaces are ignored automatically to allow for readable queries). So for example a query could look like: _ u d d [...] u d _ or [ . | . r | . r r ] u d
